title: Drifting, Discriminating, and Directioning for Action Coordination in Higher-dimensional Action Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.25385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a lightweight policy model to mitigate the difficulty of handling higher-dimensional action spaces in reinforcement learning (RL), alongside an algorithm to effectively train it. To address this, we focus on drifting models, which can implicitly represent complex distributions and infer actions in a single forward pass. However, while drifting models can be straightforwardly trained via backpropagation of the Q-gradient, this alone cannot be expected to appropriately capture the desired action coordination. Therefore, this paper constructs a three-step learning algorithm to encourage the action coordination. First, the source distribution of the drifting model is co-optimized as a diagonal policy model. This conditions the drifting model to attach the coordination, which cannot be expressed by a diagonal distribution, as residuals. Second, a discriminator model before and after drifting is introduced with adversarial

translated_title: 漂移、判别与定向：面向高维动作空间的动作协调
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种轻量级策略模型，以缓解强化学习（RL）中处理高维动作空间的困难，并提供了一种有效训练该模型的算法。为此，我们专注于漂移模型，这类模型能够隐式表示复杂分布，并在单次前向传播中推断动作。然而，尽管漂移模型可以通过Q梯度的反向传播直接训练，但仅凭这一点无法期望其恰当地捕捉所需的动作协调。因此，本文构建了一个三步学习算法来促进动作协调。首先，将漂移模型的源分布作为对角策略模型进行协同优化，这使得漂移模型将对角分布无法表达的协调作为残差进行附加。其次，引入漂移前后的判别器模型，采用对抗性训练……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于漂移模型的轻量级策略方法，通过协同优化源分布、判别与定向的三步训练算法，有效解决强化学习中高维动作空间的动作协调问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight policy model based on drifting models, trained via a three-step algorithm of co-optimization, discrimination, and directioning, to effectively achieve action coordination in higher-dimensional action spaces for reinforcement learning.
